generatedJournal.text: The whole-body synaptic connectome of a 3-day Platynereis dumerilii larva was reconstructed with over 9000 cells, detailing 202 neuronal and 92 non-neuronal cell types.

support.quote: We reconstructed and annotated over 9000 neuronal and non-neuronal cells in a whole-body serial electron microscopy dataset. Differentiated cells were classified into 202 neuronal
support.title: Whole-body connectome of a segmented annelid larva | eLife

generatedJournal.text: This Platynereis larval connectome data builds foundational knowledge for study of segmental and intersegmental neural connectivity, mushroom bodies, and broader animal nervous system evolution.

support.quote: This work lays the foundations for studies on cell type diversity, segmental vs. intersegmental connectivity, and mushroom bodies, but will certainly also be of use to scientists
support.title: Whole-body connectome of a segmented annelid larva | eLife
